verdict.rationale: Stable is a SaaS virtual-mailbox and registered-agent service with a dashboard and API, so an opt-out for telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question to ask. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics tracking, or any opt-out control. Audit logs and notification preferences are unrelated features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
